source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-13

procedures.title: Body lubrication points: Corvette
steps: Door hinge pins: light engine oil.
Door lock rotor and striker plate: light engine oil or stainless stick lubricant.
Window regulators, controls and door lock remote link: light engine oil.
Gas tank filler cap hinge: light engine oil.
Weatherstrips and rubber bumpers: a light coat of rubber lubricant.
